note: Campground at the US 2 / MN 33 roundabout in Saginaw, about 15 miles west of Duluth. Mostly seasonal: most RV sites are let for the May-October season, with a handful sold by the night. --Claude

Long-stay five tests: (1) nightly stays sold - yes, 'RV Site - FHU' nightly rate; (2) nightly price posted - yes, $40/$45 for 2026 on the site and engine; (3) no wording discouraging nightly guests (the engine says 'For seasonal reservations, enter dates May 1st to October 1st, or please contact us'); (4) nightly share - of the 44 RV sites on the engine 8 carry the nightly rate (7 shown online), 1 monthly and 35 the seasonal rate; with the 6 tent sites 14 of 50 sites sell nights (28%), above 1 in 10; (5) presence - own site with phone, online engine, Google 4.1 from 99. Passes the tests, but it IS mostly seasonal (35 of 44 RV sites, 80%, on the seasonal rate); it is not iffy (2026 rate posted, online engine, 99 reviews), so not a drop candidate on the 2026-11-11 rule. The note now says mostly seasonal. The engine returned no reservation records to a public read, so occupancy could not be measured.
Site lengths: the engine gives every RV spot a maxTrailerLength (70 ft on most, 60 and 40 on a few) - looks like a default, not written to max_rig_ft.
Waterfront: not waterfront kept; imagery shows the loops between US 2 and the rail line, no water near.
